# Color token reference

This is the complete static reference for the design system's color-bearing CSS custom properties. Run `npm run docs:color-tokens` after updating the vendored Flex themes.

## At a glance

| Inventory | Count | Source |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Resting `--gnrc-color-*` tokens | 116 | `src/styles/tokens.css` |
| Hover and pressed `--gnrc-color-*` tokens | 118 | `src/styles/tokens-interaction.css` |
| Canonical `--gnrc-color-*` total | 234 | Both canonical sources |
| Related material background colors | 3 | `src/styles/tokens.css` |
| Consumer alternate definitions | 96 | Product-theme overrides |

## Reading the values

- Light and dark columns are the exact arguments of each `light-dark()` declaration.
- A fixed color repeats the same value in both columns.
- Eight-digit hex values use `#rrggbbaa`; the final pair is alpha.
- Consumer entries are alternate values for existing tokens, not additional token names. Tokens absent from that section inherit the canonical value.
